utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Leo. I don’t think the time is firm yet, but Quinn said they’ll pass it along when it’s set—until then I can quietly remind folks not to bring things over early.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good plan, Uli. Tell folks to wait for the confirmed Saturday morning window at the community shed, and I’ll update you as soon as Quinn sets the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll keep it simple and tell folks to wait for the confirmed Saturday morning window at the community shed until Quinn has the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I hear you, Kira—I won’t ask you to tell Bo and Sam anything until it’s definite. I’m checking with Rosa and the others today, and I’ll get you the confirmed time and supply list as soon as they’re nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Cleo — can you check back by this evening even if Rosa hasn’t nailed it down yet, just so I know whether to keep Bo and Sam on standby?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Kira—I’ll check back with you this evening either way, even if all I have is a status update. I’ll tell you clearly whether Bo and Sam should stay on standby or hold off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa, I’m helping organize the repair drive this weekend, especially tools, drop-off spots, and volunteer availability—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that’s a big help. Quick update: we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so could you focus on tools, volunteer availability, and making sure folks know the new drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll update the tool list, check volunteer availability for Sunday, and make sure everyone knows the drop-off is now at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m heading to the library now to post the sign-up sheet, Hana, and I’ll add the repair categories so everyone knows where they fit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—that sounds useful; before you post it, do you know whether Friday sign-in is listed separately from the still-unconfirmed Saturday slots?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I’ll list Friday sign-in separately and mark Saturday as pending until Ira gives me the firm count before supper.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, I’ve got Faye marked for 2:30 to 3:15 on the station map, and I’m adding station and tools columns to the volunteer sign-up sheet today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks Mara—please note Leo at the community shed intake table Saturday morning with labels, tape, a marker, and a basic screwdriver set so we don’t double-assign that spot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, Opal—I’ll put Leo at the community shed intake table Saturday morning with labels, tape, a marker, and a basic screwdriver set, and I’ll make sure that spot isn’t double-assigned.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren, quick version from my side: I can cover Faye’s Friday sign-in table from 3:15 to 4, and for Saturday I’m only free later in the day—do you know who has the main drop-off list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Bo, that’s kind of you—I may be muddling it, but I think Cleo’s closest to the organizer side, so she might know where the main drop-off list is.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, thanks—I’ll check with Cleo about the main list and stick to Friday 3:15 to 4 plus later Saturday if they need me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Ira, I’m still catching up, but I know the collection table is set for Saturday morning. I’m checking who’s got tools and who can cover sign-ups, so I’ll pass along firmer details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane—that matches what I’ve been hearing, though Mina still wants the volunteer count confirmed and exact bike, lamp, and appliance numbers. I’ll keep listening while I’m out and send anything firm your way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — if you hear any firm counts for volunteers or those bike, lamp, and appliance piles, send them my way and I’ll fold them into the list before I update Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, do you have the firm volunteer count for the repair drive, and do you know what items people have already said they’re bringing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not firm yet, Mina—I’m still waiting on Cleo to confirm the exact time and supplies with the organizers, so I don’t want to give you bad numbers. Once she confirms, I’ll pass along the volunteer count and what folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine, but I need it firm today—can you ask Cleo for a deadline and tell me whether we’re still only at six maybes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact start time from Leo, Jules—Saturday morning at the community shed is all I’ve got, and I don’t want folks hauling appliances over too early.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Pia—that helps. I’ll hold off telling folks a firm time and check with Opal and Leo so we don’t have people showing up with appliances before the shed is ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be a relief, Jules—if you hear back from Leo or Opal, could you tell Tess too so we’re all giving people the same instructions?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Tess, I’m still piecing together the repair drive from what folks have told me—have you heard whether Sam’s tool crew and Maya’s drop-off group have connected yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not yet, Nell—I’ve mostly been chasing the firm drop-off time and place, but I’ll ask around about Sam’s crew and Maya’s group and pass along whatever’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess—that would help a lot. I’ve heard Jules is trying to connect those two groups, so I’ll keep checking from that end too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Faye—Rosa says folks can sign up now for repairs or supplies, though the exact date and drop-off spot are still being confirmed. I’ve heard porch steps and leaky gutters may be early priorities, but Rosa’s final list is coming after she checks with Cleo and Leo.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey—that helps. I’ll keep my school-pickup window flexible and wait for Rosa’s confirmed date and drop-off spot before nudging the other parents to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds wise, Faye—once Rosa confirms the date and spot, I can pass it along so you have the details before you nudge anyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Gus, thanks again—I’m still catching up, but I’ve got you down for the toolbox Saturday morning at the community shed, and I’ll holler if cords or a work light come up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah—I’ll bring the screwdrivers, pliers, and socket set Saturday morning, and I can toss in an extension cord and work light just in case.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, Gus, thanks—that’s probably smarter than waiting on my scattered updates. I’ll let folks know you’re covered for tools and a little extra setup help Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane, I’m glad we could connect—the repair drive is now set for Sunday at the community center, and I’d love your help making the setup run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I was still working off the Saturday collection-table note, so I’m glad you caught me up. I can help Sunday setup and I’m still checking who has tools and who can cover sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Dane—that’s exactly what we need. Please tell anyone you check with that it’s Sunday at the community center now, and I’ll keep a clear setup list ready so we can plug folks in easily.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, quick version if you can—I’m already on Friday sign-in from 3:15 to 4, and Saturday I can only help later in the day.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo. Saturday later is useful—come by the community shed after lunch and I’ll put you on tool return or pickup sorting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—after lunch at the community shed, tool return or pickup sorting. I’ll swing by then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I’m planning to bring screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set Saturday morning, plus lend a hand. Do you know if the repair drive still needs cords, a work light, or anything else?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—that sounds really useful. From what Jules told me, they’re still gathering names and busted items, so I’d bring the cords and work light too unless Sam’s crew says they’re already covered.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to know, Nell—I’ll pack the cords and work light along with the toolbox, then check in with Sam’s crew before unloading so I’m not duplicating anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I’m still piecing it together—have you heard whether we’ve really got six volunteers today, or where the drop-off spot is?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m coordinating it now, Ira; let’s not call it six until you and I have names confirmed, and I’ll set the drop-off by the library table with tools sorted by type.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Eli—I won’t repeat six yet, and I’ll help confirm names while sending folks to the library table once you’re set up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hey Faye, I’m trying not to assign anyone on maybes—can you confirm whether you’re available Saturday morning, later in the day, or not at all?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can’t confirm Saturday yet—I’m still waiting on Mara for the start time, so please don’t put me down there. I can cover the Friday after-school sign-in around 3:15 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, that’s clear—I won’t put you down for Saturday. Can you confirm you’re committed for Friday sign-in from 3:15 to 4?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Pia, I’m still gathering the urgent repair needs so Rosa can match the supply list—so far we’re focusing on tools, patch materials, batteries, porch steps, and leaky gutters.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Cleo—thank you. I’m still worried we don’t have a firm Saturday drop-off time at the shed, so could we pin that down before people start hauling things over?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, let’s not send anyone hauling supplies until the time is firm—I’ll check with Rosa about the Saturday shed drop-off and then have Vik spread the confirmed time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I think I could label one tool and quietly help point people where to go once Quinn confirms the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds perfect, Uli—one labeled tool and a little quiet directing is plenty. I’ll check in with Quinn about the quieter window and let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. A quieter window would help me a lot, so I’ll wait to hear from you or Quinn before I make any plans.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Opal! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Mara’s still finalizing the drop-off time and spot, but can I count on you to invite a couple neighbors and bring any broken household items?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—I’m coordinating station and tool locations, so I’ll invite a couple neighbors once Mara confirms the final drop-off spot. I’ll also note any broken household items I’m bringing so they land at the right station.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Opal — I’ll pass you Mara’s final drop-off spot as soon as she confirms it, and your station notes will really help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, do you know how many bikes, lamps, and small appliances are actually coming in, or who has that count?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the count yet, Mina—I’m still gathering that from each group so Opal can place tools and volunteers without overlap. If you hear any numbers on bikes, lamps, or appliances, send them my way and I’ll fold them into the station list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, Jules—I’ll ask around for those bike, lamp, and appliance numbers today. Who should I send them to, you or Eli, so we don’t split the count?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess, I’m pulling the repair drive pieces together today—Faye is penciled in for 2:30 to 3:15, and Gus can bring tools plus help once we’ve got the drop-off windows set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, Mara—that helps a lot. I’m still trying to confirm the actual drop-off window and who’s holding the sign-up sheet, then I’ll pass it around before anyone starts hauling things over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess—if you can confirm the drop-off window, I’ll keep drafting the sign-up sheet with station and tool columns and can hold it until you’re ready to pass it around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Noah—I’m still piecing it together, but Rosa’s organizing the repair drive and asked me to help spread the word about sign-ups and supply needs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh thanks, Rey—I’d heard Saturday morning at the community shed, but I’m not sure on the exact drop-off time yet. If Rosa has a sign-up sheet or supply list, I can point Pia and Gus to it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That matches what I’ve heard, Noah—I’ll check with Rosa for the exact drop-off window and the sign-up or supply list, then pass it along so Pia and Gus have the right details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Oren, I’m glad to help with the repair drive, but I’m still waiting on the confirmed Saturday start time and which role is shortest on volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Hana—yes, I’m waiting on Vik to confirm the start time too, so I’d better not guess. I think the first jobs are porch steps and leaky gutters, but Cleo may know where volunteers are shortest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—that’s helpful. I’ll hold off on promising tools or sign-up until Vik confirms the time and Cleo says where help is thinnest.
